fast.label: Fast
fast.sentence: DC fast charging, 50 kW and up. About 100 miles in 15 to 30 minutes at 150 kW or faster, closer to an hour at 50 kW.

medium.label: Medium
medium.sentence: Level 2 (AC). Adds roughly 15 to 30 miles per hour, depending on the charger and vehicle.

hotel.label: Hotel
hotel.sentence: A hotel with a listed Level 2 charger, which may be taken or out of date: check with the hotel. A free, working night usually adds 100 miles or more.

camping.label: Camping
camping.sentence: A campground RV hookup. A 50-amp (14-50) site charges at Level 2 speed with a 240 V portable charger; a 30-amp site is much slower.

outlet.label: Outlet
outlet.sentence: A household outlet (120 V). About 3 to 4 miles per hour.
